communities.name: 1. Core Entry, Contexts & Multi-Role Navigation Router
communities.description: Entry points (index.ts, App.tsx), PWA Service Worker registration, multi-role Stack & Drawer routers (AppNavigator.tsx, DrawerNavigator.tsx), 3 global Context providers (AuthContext, ThemeContext, NotificationContext), and domain types/theme.

communities.name: 2. Backend, Offline Sync Queue, Realtime Presence & Web Push Services
communities.description: 12 core services across src/lib/ and src/services/: fichaOrion84PdfGenerator (Ficha Médica Orión 84 PDF filler, lazy pdf-lib), Supabase client, Offline-First dataService with FIFO sync queue, programaService, storageService (image compression + bucket upload), autoSaveService, presenceService (Realtime), notificationService, webPushService (VAPID), docxProgramaGenerator, and graphifyBridge.

communities.name: 3. Scout Progression, Stages, Catalog & Evidence Screens
communities.description: Auth screens (LoginScreen, RegisterScreen) and core Scout journey screens: ScoutDashboardScreen, PlanProgresivoScreen (Precursor -> Rover), StageDetailScreen, CatalogSelectorScreen, EspecialidadesScreen, ProfileScreen, and ScoutFullProfileScreen.

communities.name: 4. Scouter, Jefe de Grupo & Comisionado Territorial Dashboards
communities.description: Role-segmented management dashboards: ScouterDashboardScreen (unit management), ScouterReviewScreen (stage & requirement validation), JefeGrupoScreen (group supervision, membership & photo approval), and ComisionadoDashboardScreen (Distrital, Regional, Nacional & Admin hierarchy).

communities.name: 5. Programas Scout, Plan Trimestral, Calendario & Drive Screens
communities.description: Operational planning screens: ProgramaScoutScreen, ProgramaScoutEditorScreen (schedule, 6 growth areas, SDGs, DOCX/PDF export), QuarterlyPlanScreen (individual & shared unit plans), CalendarScreen (unit/group/CIP events), ActivityCenterScreen, and TemporalDriveScreen.

communities.name: 6. Ficha Médica, Currículum Scout, Certificados & Offline Manuals
communities.description: Official records & offline reference screens: FichaMedicaScreen (DOCX export), CurriculumScoutScreen (auto-synced with certificates & DOCX export), CertificateUploadScreen, NudosManualScreen (interactive SVG knot diagrams), CancioneroScreen, and DocumentosScreen.

communities.name: 7. Reusable Modals, Avatars, Notifications & Theme Components
communities.description: 23 shared UI components in src/components/: OfflineStatusBanner, PendingChangesModal, ActividadesPersonalesModal, MembershipRecordsModal, InsigniasExportBar, ScoutQRCode, FichaMedicaOrion84Form, ScoutUserIcon, CarnetScoutModal, NochesAireLibreModal, VidaGrupoModal, ProgramaPdfPreviewModal, OnboardingGuideModal, NotificationCenterModal, NotificationHeaderBell, LiveNotificationToast, ThemeCustomizerModal, PWAInstallModal, HelpFloatingFAB, DualProfileAvatar, UserScoutAvatar, StageBadgeIcon, ManualVisualDiagram.

communities.name: 8. Supabase Schema (11 Tables), Static Catalogs & PWA/Serverless Config
communities.description: 9 normative static catalogs (src/data/*, incl. fichaMedicaOrion84Layout PDF field map), 8 utility helpers (src/utils/*), 11 Supabase PostgreSQL tables, scout-files Storage bucket, 5 SQL migration scripts, Vercel serverless endpoints (api/send-push.js, api/verificar.js, api/membership-reminders.js cron), DOCX templates, and PWA Service Worker (public/sw.js).

nodes.label: index.ts (Expo Root Entry)
nodes.role: Registers root App component with Expo registerRootComponent.

nodes.label: App.tsx (Root Providers, PWA SW & Offline Reconnect Sync)
nodes.role: Initializes Graphify Bridge, registers /sw.js Service Worker on Web, listens to window online events to flush dataService.syncPendingRequirements(), and wraps ThemeProvider -> AuthProvider -> NotificationProvider -> AppNavigator.

nodes.label: AppNavigator.tsx (Role-Based Stack Router & Deep Linking)
nodes.role: Routes unauthenticated users to Login/Register and authenticated users by role (scout -> DrawerNavigator, scouter -> ScouterDashboard, jefe_grupo -> JefeDashboard, comisionados/nacional/admin -> ComisionadoDashboard) plus shared screens.

nodes.label: DrawerNavigator.tsx (Scout Sidebar Navigation & Theme Controls)
nodes.role: 15-screen Drawer menu for Scouts with custom header avatar, dark mode toggle, ThemeCustomizerModal trigger, and PWAInstallModal trigger.

nodes.label: AuthContext.tsx (Instant Local Auth Cache + Supabase Session)
nodes.role: Restores @scout_cached_profile in <10ms with 800ms safety timeout, syncs Supabase Auth session & profiles table, initializes presenceService, and exposes updateUserProfile/refreshProfile/signOut.

nodes.label: ThemeContext.tsx (Dark Mode & Custom Primary Palette)
nodes.role: Persists app_dark_mode and app_primary_color in AsyncStorage and provides dynamic theme tokens across all screens.

nodes.label: NotificationContext.tsx (Realtime Notifications & Toasts)
nodes.role: Polls & subscribes to scout_notifications/notifications, manages unread badge counts, triggers LiveNotificationToast, and registers Web Push subscriptions.

nodes.label: progression.ts (Core Role, Unit, Profile & Stage Types)
nodes.role: Defines Role (7 roles), Unit (6 units), StageStatus, Profile, Requirement, StageTemplate, StageProgress, and RequirementProgress.

nodes.label: programa.ts (ProgramaScout & Schedule Domain Types)
nodes.role: Defines ProgramaScout and ActivityScheduleItem interfaces.

nodes.label: colors.ts (Design System Color Tokens)
nodes.role: Central color palette for units, stages, and dark/light surfaces.

nodes.label: supabaseClient.ts (Supabase Client Singleton)
nodes.role: Configures @supabase/supabase-js with AsyncStorage session persistence.

nodes.label: supabase.ts (Supabase Helper Re-export)
nodes.role: Re-exports configured Supabase instance.

nodes.label: dataService.ts (Offline Sync Queue, Progression, Logs & Certificates)
nodes.role: Async data layer on top of the offline outbox (@scout_outbox_v1) with cached reads: stage/requirement progress, stage/requirement progress, stage review/approval, certificates + curriculum auto-sync, quarterly plans, CIP events, nights log, vida de grupo log, and membership dates.

nodes.label: outbox.ts (Offline Outbox Queue)
nodes.role: Generic ordered queue of pending operations (@scout_outbox_v1). run() executes now or queues; flush() replays in order when back online, on app focus and every 30 s; network errors wait, other errors retry 5 times then stay as failed. Migrates the old @scout_offline_sync_queue.

nodes.label: net.ts (Connectivity & Supabase error helpers)
nodes.role: isOnline, isNetworkError, isRetryableError, must() (supabase-js returns {error} instead of throwing when offline), isDuplicateError, newId (UUID).

nodes.label: readCache.ts (Network-first reads with local copy)
nodes.role: cachedQuery(key, fetcher, fallback): returns fresh data and stores a copy (@scout_rc_*), or the last copy when offline / timeout.

nodes.label: offlineDocs.ts (PDF guides available offline)
nodes.role: Saves guide PDFs in Cache Storage scoutplan-docs-v1 (shared with public/sw.js); appPdfUrl() routes scouts.org.ve guides through the /asv-pdf/* proxy in vercel.json.

nodes.label: programaService.ts (CRUD & Offline Sync for Programas Scout)
nodes.role: Manages scout_programas table and @scout_programas_list local cache with getProgramas, savePrograma, deletePrograma, and duplicatePrograma.

nodes.label: programaNotes.ts (Hidden metadata tags in Programa notes)
nodes.role: visibleNotes() strips PLAN_ACT_ID/PROGRAMA_STATUS/PREVIEW_ROLES/AUTHOR_ID/AUTHOR_NAME tags and extra blank lines for the editor, preview and .docx; notesWithMeta() rebuilds them together under the text on save (no blank-line growth).

nodes.label: fileUrl.ts (Signed URLs for private scout-files)
nodes.role: resolveFileUrl/peekFileUrl/openFileUrl/clearFileCache: stored public-form URLs -> createSignedUrl (1 h) cached in memory + @scout_signed_urls_v1; offline falls back to last URL (SW caches by path without token); cleared on logout.

nodes.label: insigniasReport.ts (Badge progress report builder)
nodes.role: Bulk-reads stage_progress and requirement_progress (chunks of 80 ids) and builds a ReportTable: summary per member + detail per stage with approval dates.

nodes.label: fichaScoutPdfGenerator.ts (Ficha Médica Scout PDF)
nodes.role: Draws the Ficha Médica Scout as a one-page PDF with pdf-lib from the same replacements used by the .docx template, including the signature image.

nodes.label: reportTable.ts + xlsxWriter.ts + pdfTableWriter.ts (Real Excel & direct PDF)
nodes.role: ReportTable model; OOXML .xlsx writer with JSZip (merged title, frozen header, autofilter, colored cells) and landscape PDF writer with pdf-lib (wrapped cells, repeated header, page X of Y). Used by Censo, Padrón, Membresías, Plan Trimestral and Insignias.

nodes.label: storageService.ts (Canvas Image Compression & Supabase Storage)
nodes.role: Compresses images >800px via HTML5 Canvas and uploads to scout-files Supabase Storage bucket.

nodes.label: docxProgramaGenerator.ts (OpenXML DOCX Generator for Programas)
nodes.role: Generates official ASV Word .docx files for ProgramaScout using JSZip and public/programa_assets/Programa_Template.docx.

nodes.label: graphifyBridge.ts (Runtime Bridge window.__SCOUT_GRAPHIFY__)
nodes.role: Mounts window.__SCOUT_GRAPHIFY__ for Claude Code programmatic navigation, state inspection, and diagnostics.

nodes.label: autoSaveService.ts (Debounced Form Draft Persistence)
nodes.role: Debounced 300ms draft auto-saver in AsyncStorage (@scout_autosave_*) for long forms.

nodes.label: notificationService.ts (Multi-Target Notification Dispatcher)
nodes.role: Dispatches in-app, browser, and Web Push notifications to users, units, groups, or roles via scout_notifications.

nodes.label: presenceService.ts (Supabase Realtime Online Presence)
nodes.role: Tracks online/offline status of scouts and scouters via Supabase Realtime channel scout_presence_global and updates profiles.updated_at.

nodes.label: fichaOrion84PdfGenerator.ts (Ficha Médica Orión 84 PDF Filler)
nodes.role: Fills public/FICHA_MEDICA_ORION84_Template.pdf (Canva, no AcroForm) by drawing text at measured cell coordinates; auto-shrinks/wraps with ellipsis; lazy-loads pdf-lib/dist bundle (the ESM build breaks Metro via tslib).

nodes.label: webPushService.ts (VAPID Web Push Subscription & Dispatch)
nodes.role: Registers Service Worker PushManager subscriptions in push_subscriptions and invokes /api/send-push.

nodes.label: LoginScreen.tsx (route: Login)
nodes.role: Email/password authentication, password recovery modal, and link to RegisterScreen.

nodes.label: RegisterScreen.tsx (route: Register)
nodes.role: Multi-role user registration (Scout, Scouter, Jefe de Grupo, Comisionado) with Region, District, Group, and Unit selectors.

nodes.label: ScoutDashboardScreen.tsx (route: Resumen)
nodes.role: Main Scout home dashboard: ScoutUserIcon greeting badge, progression summary, active stage progress bar, unit Rovers directory (directorio_grupo RPC), quick access cards, CarnetScoutModal, OnboardingGuideModal, and HelpFloatingFAB.

nodes.label: PlanProgresivoScreen.tsx (route: PlanProgresivo)
nodes.role: Displays the 4 Rover/Clan progression stages (Precursor, Expedicionario, Descubridor, Fundador) with completion percentages and lock status.

nodes.label: StageDetailScreen.tsx (route: StageDetail)
nodes.role: Interactive checklist of stage requirements, linking to CatalogSelectorScreen, NochesAireLibreModal, VidaGrupoModal, CertificateUploadScreen, and stage review submission.

nodes.label: CatalogSelectorScreen.tsx (route: CatalogSelector)
nodes.role: Searchable selector for official ASV catalog activities (básicas, opcionales, especialidades, cursos, ciclos) filtered by stage and requirement type.

nodes.label: EspecialidadesScreen.tsx (route: Especialidades)
nodes.role: Interactive catalog of Scout Specialties across 6 categories and 3 levels (Bronce, Plata, Oro).

nodes.label: ProfileScreen.tsx (route: Perfil)
nodes.role: Scout & Scouter personal profile editor: dual avatars (Uniformado/Casual), cédula, dates (birth, promise, join), membership expiration proposal, and digital Carnet Scout.

nodes.label: ScoutFullProfileScreen.tsx (route: ScoutFullProfile)
nodes.role: 360-degree view of a Scout profile for Scouters/Jefes: progression stages, certificates, medical record summary, curriculum, and membership status.

nodes.label: ScouterDashboardScreen.tsx (route: ScouterDashboard)
nodes.role: Unit leader dashboard: lists unit scouts with online presence, pending stage reviews, quarterly plan feedback, unit programs, and profile photo moderation.

nodes.label: ScouterReviewScreen.tsx (route: ScouterReview)
nodes.role: Detailed requirement-by-requirement verification screen for a Scout with Approve/Reject stage actions and notification dispatch.

nodes.label: JefeGrupoScreen.tsx (route: JefeDashboard)
nodes.role: Group Chief dashboard: supervises all units (Manada, Tropa, Caminantes, Clan), approves/rejects membership expiration dates, moderates photos, and manages group calendar.

nodes.label: ComisionadoDashboardScreen.tsx (route: ComisionadoDashboard)
nodes.role: Territorial hierarchy dashboard (Distrital, Regional, Nacional, Admin) with drill-down metrics by Region -> District -> Group -> Unit.

nodes.label: ProgramaScoutScreen.tsx (route: ProgramaScout)
nodes.role: Lists unit & sinodal Scout Activity Programs with filters by unit, duplicate/delete actions, PDF preview modal, and Word .docx export.

nodes.label: ProgramaScoutEditorScreen.tsx (route: ProgramaScoutEditor)
nodes.role: Full editor for ProgramaScout: metadata, unit/sinodal selector, objectives, SDGs (17 ODS), 6 Growth Area achievement indicators, time-table schedule, and autoSaveService integration.

nodes.label: QuarterlyPlanScreen.tsx (route: QuarterlyPlan)
nodes.role: Quarterly planner (Trimestres I-IV) supporting individual Rover plans and shared unit plans linked to ProgramaScoutEditor.

nodes.label: CalendarScreen.tsx (route: CalendarStandalone)
nodes.role: Interactive calendar (react-native-calendars) for unit, group, district, and CIP events with event creation and reminders.

nodes.label: ActivityCenterScreen.tsx (route: CentroActividades)
nodes.role: Hub for CIP events, unit activities, and direct launch of activity programs.

nodes.label: TemporalDriveScreen.tsx (route: TemporalDrive)
nodes.role: Photo evidence albums organized by activity/date, backed by Supabase Storage scout-files and @scout_temporal_drive_albums cache.

nodes.label: FichaMedicaScreen.tsx (route: FichaMedica)
nodes.role: Two-tab medical record: "Ficha Médica Scout" (ASV form, Word .docx export) and "Ficha Médica Orión 84" (FichaMedicaOrion84Form, PDF export). Both live in profiles.medical_data (Orión 84 under medical_data.orion84; saves merge, never overwrite each other).

nodes.label: CurriculumScoutScreen.tsx (route: CurriculumScout)
nodes.role: Official Scout Curriculum Vitae form auto-synced with uploaded certificates, awards, and progression stages, with Word .docx export.

nodes.label: CertificateUploadScreen.tsx (route: CertificateUpload)
nodes.role: Uploads and categorizes Scout certificates/courses to Supabase Storage and syncs them automatically into CurriculumScout.

nodes.label: NudosManualScreen.tsx (route: NudosManual)
nodes.role: 100% offline interactive manual of Scout knots, lashings (amarres), camping techniques, and visual SVG diagrams (ManualVisualDiagram).

nodes.label: CancioneroScreen.tsx (route: Cancionero)
nodes.role: Offline Scout songbook categorized by unit (Manada, Tropa, Caminantes, Clan, Fogata) with search and chords/lyrics.

nodes.label: DocumentosScreen.tsx (route: Documentos)
nodes.role: Digital library of official ASV & WOSM PDF manuals and Mundialito guides stored in public/documentos/.

nodes.label: CarnetScoutModal.tsx (Digital Scout ID Card)
nodes.role: Renders official digital Scout ID card with QR verification, membership status badge, and PDF/image export.

nodes.label: NochesAireLibreModal.tsx (Camping Nights Logbook)
nodes.role: Modal logbook for recording camping nights (date, location, nights count, notes) toward stage requirements.

nodes.label: VidaGrupoModal.tsx (Group Life Logbook)
nodes.role: Modal logbook for recording Vida de Grupo participations and council activities.

nodes.label: ProgramaPdfPreviewModal.tsx (HTML/PDF Programa Preview)
nodes.role: Renders official ASV formatted preview of a ProgramaScout with html2pdf / print export.

nodes.label: OnboardingGuideModal.tsx (Interactive Welcome Tour)
nodes.role: Step-by-step interactive onboarding guide for new Scouts and Scouters.

nodes.label: NotificationCenterModal.tsx (Inbox & Announcements Modal)
nodes.role: Displays personal notifications and official system announcements with mark-as-read and clear actions.

nodes.label: NotificationHeaderBell.tsx (Unread Bell Badge)
nodes.role: Header bell button with animated unread counter opening NotificationCenterModal.

nodes.label: LiveNotificationToast.tsx (Floating In-App Toast)
nodes.role: Global top toast banner displaying incoming real-time notifications.

nodes.label: ThemeCustomizerModal.tsx (Palette & Dark Mode Picker)
nodes.role: Modal allowing users to customize primary accent color and dark/light theme.

nodes.label: PWAInstallModal.tsx (iOS/Android/Desktop Install Guide)
nodes.role: Triggers native beforeinstallprompt or displays step-by-step iOS Safari Add to Home Screen instructions.

nodes.label: HelpFloatingFAB.tsx (Support & Bug Report FAB)
nodes.role: Floating action button submitting diagnostic bug reports to bug_reports table.

nodes.label: DualProfileAvatar.tsx (Scout Uniform & Casual Avatar)
nodes.role: Scout (uniform) and personal photo tabs; always opens on «Foto Scout» and each tab shows ONLY its own photo. In lists (Resumen, Rovers, dashboards) only the scout photo or the scout icon is shown — the personal photo never replaces it (fix 2026-11-09). Uploads via onUpload, images through SecureImage (signed URLs).

nodes.label: UserScoutAvatar.tsx (Unit-Badged Avatar)
nodes.role: Renders user avatar with unit logo fallback and role badge.

nodes.label: StageBadgeIcon.tsx (SVG Progression Stage Insignia)
nodes.role: Renders vector insignias for Precursor, Expedicionario, Descubridor, and Fundador.

nodes.label: FichaMedicaOrion84Form.tsx (Ficha Médica Orión 84 Form)
nodes.role: Orión 84 medical form: prefilled from profile + Ficha Médica Scout, autosaved draft, saves to profiles.medical_data.orion84 and downloads the filled PDF.

nodes.label: ScoutUserIcon.tsx (User Silhouette with Scout Neckerchief)
nodes.role: SVG user icon wearing a neckerchief in the unit color; shown above the name on the Scout home greeting.

nodes.label: OfflineStatusBanner.tsx (Offline / Sync status pill)
nodes.role: Shows "Sin conexión · N", "Enviando…", "Todo enviado" or failed changes with retry; collapses to a small chip under the header so it never covers bottom action buttons.

nodes.label: PendingChangesModal.tsx (Pending offline changes list)
nodes.role: Opened from OfflineStatusBanner: lists queued outbox operations in send order, failed ones with a friendly error, retry-all and discard-one actions.

nodes.label: ActividadesPersonalesModal.tsx (Personal activities logbook)
nodes.role: Logbook for "Actividades Personales (3 de su propia creación)": name, date and description per activity, stored as certificates rows personal_<stage>_<req>; auto-checks the requirement at the required count.

nodes.label: MembershipRecordsModal.tsx (ASV payment receipt & membership history)
nodes.role: mode=self: the member uploads the payment receipt (photo + reference + amount); mode=leader: Scouter/Jefatura view receipts and the year-by-year history of approvals and returns. Rows in certificates (membresia_pago / membresia_hist).

nodes.label: PendingAccountsCard.tsx (Approve new accounts)
nodes.role: Lists accounts with account_status pending/rejected for Scouter (own unit) and Jefatura (group); Approve/Reject via dataService.setAccountStatus.

nodes.label: SecureImage.tsx (Image for the private bucket)
nodes.role: Drop-in <Image> + useFileUrl(): resolves scout-files URLs to 1-hour signed URLs before rendering; other URIs pass through.

nodes.label: InsigniasExportBar.tsx (Badge progress export)
nodes.role: Card with Excel/PDF buttons for the badge progress report of a unit or the whole group (online only).

nodes.label: ScoutQRCode.tsx (Offline QR renderer)
nodes.role: Draws a QR code on-device with qrcode-generator + react-native-svg (replaces api.qrserver.com, works offline).

nodes.label: ManualVisualDiagram.tsx (SVG Knot & Lashing Diagrams)
nodes.role: Renders step-by-step vector diagrams for knots, lashings, and camping setups.

nodes.label: progressionTemplate.ts (Stages & Requirements Catalog)
nodes.role: Defines Precursor, Expedicionario, Descubridor, and Fundador stage requirements.

nodes.label: unitTemplates.ts (Units, age ranges & stage templates)
nodes.role: Manada 7-10, Tropa 10-15, Caminantes 16-18, Clan 18-21; ageFitForUnit / ageFitLabel for the census age check; getStagesForUnit falls back to the Clan template until the other templates are loaded.

nodes.label: activitiesCatalog.ts (Official ASV Activities Catalog)
nodes.role: Full catalog of ASV activities mapped to stages and requirement types.

nodes.label: achievementIndicatorsData.ts (6 Growth Areas Indicators)
nodes.role: Indicators across Corporalidad, Creatividad, Carácter, Afectividad, Sociabilidad, and Espiritualidad for Manada, Tropa, Caminantes, and Clan.

nodes.label: specialtiesData.ts (Scout Specialties Catalog)
nodes.role: Catalog of Scout specialties and requirements across Bronce, Plata, and Oro levels.

nodes.label: documentsData.ts (PDF Manuals Metadata)
nodes.role: Metadata and file paths for official PDF guides in public/documentos/.

nodes.label: sdgData.ts (17 UN Sustainable Development Goals)
nodes.role: 17 ODS definitions, colors, and icons for ProgramaScout.

nodes.label: registrationBadgesData.ts (Annual Registration Badges)
nodes.role: Institutional registration badges and Mundialito programs.

nodes.label: trimestresData.ts (Quarterly Planning Templates)
nodes.role: Quarter definitions and suggested milestones.

nodes.label: fichaMedicaOrion84Layout.ts (Ficha Orión 84 Field Map)
nodes.role: Single source of truth for the Orión 84 form: field labels/types and exact PDF cell coordinates, plus titles printed on the template blank header bars.

nodes.label: docxExporter.ts (Ficha Médica & Currículum DOCX Exporter)
nodes.role: Injects user data and images into Ficha Médica and Currículum Scout Word .docx templates.

nodes.label: api/send-push.js (Vercel Web Push Serverless Function)
nodes.role: Dispatches encrypted RFC 8030 Web Push payloads using web-push and VAPID keys.

nodes.label: api/verificar.js (Carnet verification, login required)
nodes.role: GET /api/verificar?id=<uuid> requires a logged-in user (401 otherwise); with the service role returns only name, group, unit/role and membership status/expiry; Cache-Control private, no-store.

nodes.label: CuentaEnRevisionScreen.tsx (Account under review)
nodes.role: Only screen for accounts with account_status pending/rejected (AppNavigator gate): explains the review, re-check button (refreshProfile) and sign out. Shows no group data.

nodes.label: AdministracionScreen.tsx (Groups & roles admin)
nodes.role: Route Administracion (/administracion). Jefe de Grupo: people of own group (Scout/Scouter/Jefe, unit, approve). Comisionados: also create groups (scout_groups) and move people inside their territory. Admin/Nacional: whole country, all roles. Rules mirrored by proteger_perfil.

nodes.label: territory.ts (Regions, districts, groups & role labels)
nodes.role: Single source for REGIONS, static districts/groups (fallback), districtsFor/groupsFor (merge scout_groups), ROLE_LABELS, assignableRoles, canMoveMembers. Used by Register, Comisionado dashboard and Administracion.

nodes.label: NuevaContrasenaScreen.tsx (Set new password)
nodes.role: Gate shown while AuthContext.recoveryMode (entered via the «¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?» email link): supabase.auth.updateUser({password}), min 8 chars, then endRecovery().

nodes.label: authRecovery.ts (Password recovery link)
nodes.role: detectSessionInUrl is false, so this reads #access_token…&type=recovery (or #error_code) once, wipes it from the URL, keeps a sessionStorage flag across reloads; recoveryRedirectUrl() for resetPasswordForEmail.

nodes.label: DeleteAccountModal.tsx (Delete my account)
nodes.role: DeleteAccountButton + typed confirmation (BORRAR) → POST /api/delete-account → signOut. Used in ProfileScreen, CuentaEnRevisionScreen and the own row of AdministracionScreen.

nodes.label: PullToRefreshScrollView.tsx (Pull to refresh)
nodes.role: ScrollView with pull-to-refresh: native RefreshControl; on web custom touch handling (react-native-web has no gesture). Used by Inicio, Jefe, Scouter, Comisionado and Administracion.

nodes.label: api/delete-account.js (Self account deletion)
nodes.role: requireUser + confirm BORRAR; service role: archivos_de_usuario → storage remove, borrar_datos_de_cuenta (personal data; group content kept without author; audit row), auth.admin.deleteUser.

nodes.label: api/pending-push.js (Push for accounts to approve)
nodes.role: Called after sign-up: only if caller is pending, pushes to the recipients the avisar_cuenta_pendiente trigger already notified in the last 15 min (tag pending_<id>, no stacking).

nodes.label: cipLogic.ts (CIP rules)
nodes.role: currentStageId (first non-approved stage), cipRequirement/cipTargetFor (stage + nivel → <x>_cip_<nivel> requirement), stagesWithCip, parseCipMeta, LEY_CONFIANZA text, NIVEL_LABEL.

nodes.label: CipManagerModal.tsx (Gestionar CIP)
nodes.role: Scouter/Jefatura: catalog of official CIPs (cip_oficiales: create, list), mark attendance per youth (cip_sel_* in certificates, counts to the current stage requirement of that level), review old-CIP requests (cip_sol_*) made under the Scout Law.

nodes.label: CipStageModal.tsx (Youth CIP view)
nodes.role: Youth view of a CIP requirement: credited CIPs (badge «anterior a la app»), own requests with status, form to request a pre-app CIP with Scout Law confirmation. Replaces the old self-selection modal in StageDetail.

nodes.label: tests/sql/run.mjs (Database security tests)
nodes.role: npm run test:sql — in-memory Postgres (PGlite) with Supabase stubs (auth.uid, roles, storage, realtime); runs every supabase_*.sql twice in production order and ~78 permission checks (cross-group, self-approval, CIP, history, deletion, notifications, private presence).

nodes.label: api/backup.js (Weekly database backup)
nodes.role: Vercel cron (Sundays 07:00 UTC, vercel.json). Requires Bearer CRON_SECRET always. Dumps 15 tables with the service key into a gzip JSON in the PRIVATE storage bucket «respaldos» (created on first run), keeps the last 8. Files/photos are not copied.

nodes.label: PdfViewer.tsx (In-app PDF viewer)
nodes.role: Renders PDF pages to canvas with pdf.js (public/pdfjs, Apache-2.0, loaded on demand, precached for offline) because Android browsers do not show PDFs inside an iframe. Zoom 100–300 %, fallback «Abrir en otra aplicación». Used by DocumentosScreen.

nodes.label: apiClient.ts (Calls to /api with session token)
nodes.role: apiUrl (relative on Vercel, absolute in local dev), postApi/getApi send the Supabase session token so every /api function can require a logged-in user (rule «nada sin sesión»).

nodes.label: offline/warmup.ts (Offline pre-download of every screen)
nodes.role: warmOfflineData(user): with internet, fetches in the background the data of ALL the user screens (stages, requirements, certificates, profile row, quarterly plan, programs, calendar, unit directory) so they work offline even if never opened. Called by AuthContext 4 s after the profile loads and on «online»; at most every 10 min.

nodes.label: calendarData.ts (Calendar events loader)
nodes.role: loadCalendarEvents(user): calendar_events + quarterly plan activities + CIP catalog + scout_programas with offline copy (only server data refreshes the copy) and pending offline events; monthNumber(). Used by CalendarScreen and warmup.

nodes.label: PhotoCropModal.tsx (Crop & adjust profile photo)
nodes.role: Drag to move, pinch / slider / buttons to zoom 1×–4×, rotate 90°, circular guide; outputs an 800×800 JPEG data URL. Math in src/utils/photoCrop.ts (unit tested). Used by DualProfileAvatar (new photo and «Recortar / Ajustar» of the saved one) and CurriculumScoutScreen.

nodes.label: programaEditor/DatePickerModal.tsx (Program date calendar)
nodes.role: Month calendar with quick dates (today, next Saturday/Sunday) for ProgramaScoutEditorScreen.

nodes.label: programaEditor/IndicatorPickerModal.tsx (Official ASV indicators picker)
nodes.role: Search and toggle official achievement indicators of one growth area (per unit / sinodal) or add a custom one, for ProgramaScoutEditorScreen.

nodes.label: programaEditor/DragHandle.tsx (Drag grip for schedule items)
nodes.role: PanResponder grip (#n) that drags a schedule activity with finger or mouse (touch-action none on web); a tap without moving opens the up/down arrows. Positions and auto-scroll come from programaEditor/useScheduleDrag.ts.

nodes.label: manualsData.ts (Scout manuals content)
nodes.role: Content of the 5 offline manuals (knots & lashings, fires, sign language, tracking, first aid) with visual steps and multimedia; types ManualItem/VisualStep. Rendered by NudosManualScreen.

nodes.label: tests/e2e/run.mjs (Screen E2E tests)
nodes.role: npm run test:e2e — builds and opens the app in Chromium with Supabase MOCKED (tests/e2e/mockSupabase.mjs): 25 screens × 4 roles × light/dark (no JS errors, no endless spinner, content visible, contrast ≥ 3:1), program editor modals, and cold start offline with an expired session.

nodes.label: BadgeCelebrationWatcher.tsx (Badge approval celebration trigger)
nodes.role: Mounted in App.tsx (scouts only, web). On open, on «badge» notifications and on returning to the app, compares stage_progress with @scout_celebrated_stages_<id> via planCelebrations(); shows each newly approved stage once (first run: only those approved in the last 7 days). Skipped under navigator.webdriver.

nodes.label: celebration.web.ts (Full-screen badge celebration)
nodes.role: showBadgeCelebration(): HTML/CSS overlay animating only transform/opacity (rays, ripples, confetti); the unit max badge (last stage, Clan = Rover Ciudadano) gets the golden version with fireworks, golden rain and stars. Queues several, waits for the start splash; celebration.ts is the native no-op.

nodes.label: celebrationVideo.web.ts (Badge celebration MP4)
nodes.role: openCelebrationVideo()/createCelebrationVideo(): draws the celebration on a 720x1280 canvas frame by frame (scout name, group, badge, approval date, scout logo from scoutLogoPaths.ts) and encodes MP4 H.264 on the device with mediabunny (WebCodecs, lazy-loaded chunk); MediaRecorder fallback. Dialog with progress, preview, download and Web Share. Nothing is uploaded.

nodes.label: badgeCelebration.ts (Which badges to celebrate)
nodes.role: Pure planCelebrations(statuses, seen, dates, order) and isMaxBadge(); unit-tested in tests/unit/badgeCelebration.test.mjs.

nodes.label: errorReporter.ts (Automatic error reports)
nodes.role: installErrorReporter() listens to window error / unhandledrejection; reportError() stores «[Error automático]» rows in bug_reports with route, app version, device and stack. Ignores network/offline errors and browser extensions; same error max once a day per device and 5 per session; queued offline. Fatal (screen crash) also notifies Telegram with retries.

nodes.label: AppErrorBoundary.tsx (Crashed screen fallback)
nodes.role: Wraps AppNavigator: if a screen throws while rendering, shows «Algo salió mal» with «Volver a intentar» / «Ir al inicio» instead of a blank page, and reports it as fatal.

nodes.label: AppErrorsModal.tsx («🐞 Errores de la app»)
nodes.role: Jefatura panel listing automatic errors and manual bug reports of the group (RLS reportes_jefatura_ver in supabase_errores_app.sql), expandable detail.

nodes.label: scripts/restore-backup.mjs (Restore weekly backup)
nodes.role: --list backups in bucket «respaldos»; dry run by default; --apply upserts by id through the REST API with the service key (never deletes newer data); --tables filter. Logic in scripts/lib/backupRestore.mjs, tested in tests/sql/run.mjs (backup → damage → restore → compare).

nodes.label: PanelHeader.tsx (Common dashboard header)
nodes.role: Shared header of Scouter, Jefatura and Comisionado dashboards: role pill + bell/colors/dark/sign-out buttons on top, full-width name below (replaces three different headers; Comisionado no longer amber).

nodes.label: Skeleton.tsx (Loading skeletons)
nodes.role: SkeletonScreen variants dashboard/list/form/profile/panel with pulsing grey blocks instead of a lone spinner (role=progressbar so E2E still detects endless loading). Used in 13 screens.

nodes.label: AutoGrowTextInput.tsx (Auto-growing multiline input)
nodes.role: Multiline TextInput that grows and shrinks with its text; on web measures the textarea scrollHeight and re-measures when the width changes (ResizeObserver), on native uses onContentSizeChange.

nodes.label: api/telegram-notify.js (Bug reports to Telegram)
nodes.role: Sends suggestions/bug reports (optional screenshot) from HelpFloatingFAB to the team Telegram chat. Requires session AND an approved account; bot token only in Vercel env vars.

nodes.label: VerificarCarnetScreen.tsx (In-app carnet verification /verificar/:id)
nodes.role: Opened by the carnet QR. Logged out: AppNavigator saves the id (@pending_verify_id) and LoginScreen shows a notice; after login it navigates here and calls /api/verificar with the session token.

nodes.label: api/membership-reminders.js (Daily membership reminder cron)
nodes.role: Vercel Cron 13:00 UTC: memberships expiring in 30 and 7 days -> scout_notifications + web push to the member and their unit Scouters (Jefatura for Scouters or units without Scouter); no repeats within 20 h; CRON_SECRET if set.

nodes.label: public/sw.js (PWA Service Worker & Push Listener)
nodes.role: Caches static assets for offline operation and handles push/notificationclick events.

nodes.label: supabase_master_fix_all_tables.sql (Master PostgreSQL Schema & RLS)
nodes.role: Idempotent SQL master script defining tables, columns, RLS policies, and storage buckets.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.profiles
nodes.role: Users, roles, units, groups, districts, regions, avatars, medical/curriculum JSON, nights/vida_grupo logs, and membership status.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.stage_progress
nodes.role: Stage status per scout (En Progreso, En Revision, Aprobada, Bloqueada).

nodes.label: DB Table: public.requirement_progress
nodes.role: Individual requirement completion records synced with offline queue.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.certificates
nodes.role: Uploaded certificates with title, category, level, file_url, and date.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.scout_programas
nodes.role: Unit & sinodal activity programs with schedule, indicators, and SDGs.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.quarterly_plans
nodes.role: Individual and shared unit quarterly plans with Scouter feedback.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.calendar_events
nodes.role: Calendar and CIP events by unit, group, and district.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.scout_notifications
nodes.role: Targeted in-app notifications by user, role, unit, or group.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.notifications
nodes.role: Direct sender-to-receiver notifications.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.push_subscriptions
nodes.role: Browser/PWA Web Push VAPID endpoints and keys per user.

nodes.label: DB Table: public.bug_reports
nodes.role: User feedback and bug reports submitted from HelpFloatingFAB.

hyperedges.name: Offline-First Progression & Stage Approval Flow
hyperedges.description: Scout toggles requirements or selects catalog activities (queued in the @scout_outbox_v1 outbox if offline, replayed automatically when back online) -> submits stage for review -> Scouter approves/rejects in ScouterReviewScreen -> triggers real-time + Web Push notification.

hyperedges.name: Programa Scout Creation, Indicators, SDGs & DOCX Export Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Leaders/Rovers design unit or sinodal programs selecting 6 Growth Area indicators and 17 UN SDGs -> auto-saved locally -> persisted to scout_programas -> exported to official ASV Word .docx or PDF.

hyperedges.name: Certificate Upload & Automatic Curriculum Scout Synchronization
hyperedges.description: Uploading a certificate compresses and stores the image in scout-files bucket, inserts into certificates table, and automatically synchronizes the achievement into the Scout Curriculum JSON for instant .docx export.

hyperedges.name: Multi-Role National Territorial Hierarchy (Scout -> Unidad -> Grupo -> Distrito -> Región -> Nacional)
hyperedges.description: Role-gated navigation and data scoping across all 7 organizational levels of the Asociación de Scouts de Venezuela.
